name: webobsidian
description: WebObsidian — a self-hosted Obsidian-compatible web app

scripts.test: npm --workspace server run test && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 web/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm --workspace mcp-server run build && npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace packages/webo run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/webo run typecheck && npm --workspace mcp-server run typecheck
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dist:publish
